$comment: Segment bindings of a planar truss (Truss2D outputs x[i], y[i], util[k], failed[k]): a cylinder member between nodes 2 and 10 in the xz plane at depth 1.5 m, coloured by its signed utilisation (coolwarm, compression blue, tension red) and drawn snapped once it fails; a deck box stretched along its x axis between two deck nodes and hidden when broken; and a member of a 3D frame between two spatial points.
